features: ⚡ Fast Charging up to 27W: Charge your compatible iPhone, iPad, and AirPods quickly with up to 27W Power Delivery when paired with a compatible USB Type-C PD charger. Ideal for fast charging supported Apple devices.

📱 Universal Apple Compatibility: Compatible with iPhone 14, iPhone 14 Plus, iPhone 14 Pro, iPhone 14 Pro Max, iPhone 13 Series, iPhone 12 Series, iPhone 11 Series, iPhone XS/XS Max/XR/X, iPhone 8/8 Plus, iPhone SE (2nd & 3rd Gen), AirPods, AirPods Pro, Lightning-enabled iPads, and other Apple devices with a Lightning connector.
🔄 Fast Data Sync: Supports data transfer speeds of up to 480 Mbps, allowing you to quickly transfer photos, videos, music, and other files between your Apple devices and USB-C enabled computers.
💪 Premium & Durable Build: Made with high-quality materials and reinforced connectors for enhanced durability, flexibility, and long-lasting everyday performance.

🛡️ Safe & Reliable Charging: Apple MFi certification ensures full compatibility with iOS devices, while built-in protection helps guard against overcurrent, overheating, overcharging, and short circuits.
description: Sakit Type-C to Lightning Cable is designed to deliver fast, safe, and reliable charging for your Apple devices. Featuring MFi Certification, it guarantees full compatibility with Lightning-enabled iPhones, iPads, and AirPods while protecting your device from charging errors and compatibility issues. Supporting up to 27W Power Delivery Fast Charging, this cable helps charge compatible iPhones significantly faster when used with a Type-C PD charger. It also supports 480 Mbps high-speed data transfer, making it easy to sync photos, videos, music, and other files. Constructed using premium-quality materials with reinforced connectors, the cable is built to withstand daily wear and repeated bending for long-lasting durability. Its tangle-free design makes it convenient for use at home, in the office, in the car, or while traveling. Whether you need a dependable cable or an extra cable for work or travel, the SAKIT MFi Certified Type-C to Lightning Cable delivers the perfect combination of speed, safety, durability, and reliable performance!
